**Pet‑friendly “train” options around Miami** | Transit mode | Main hub(s) near downtown Miami | Typical pet policy | |---------------|----------------------------------|--------------------| | **Metrorail (Miami‑Dade Metro)** | *Downtown/Brickell* – 1st Ave & Brickell Ave
*South Beach* – Ocean Dr & Collins Ave | Leashed pets allowed on all cars. No separate “pet‑only” area, so keep your dog calm and quiet. | | **Tri‑Rail (regional commuter line)** | *Miami Central Station* – 2nd St & Flagler Rd (serves North/South FL)
*North Miami / Doral* – 8th Ave & NW 7th St | Small pets in carrier permitted on board during off‑peak hours. Check schedule before traveling. | | **Amtrak (intercity service)** | *Miami Central Station* – same address above | Dogs in carriers accepted on most routes. Must remain inside a carrier at all times. | ### How to confirm pet rules 1. **Call ahead** - **Metrorail:** 305‑361‑2000 (Customer Service) - **Tri‑Rail:** 305‑362‑4000 (Reservations) - **Amtrak:** 800‑878‑7799 (National Customer Service) 2. **Check online** • Each operator’s website lists “Pets” under FAQs. • Look for terms like “small animal,” “carrier,” or “leash.” 3. **Bring documentation** • Some lines require proof of vaccination if you’re bringing more than one dog or a larger animal. --- #### Quick tip for travelers who prefer a true “station” experience: If you’re heading out of town from Miami, consider using **Miami Central Station**—it serves both Tri‑Rail and Amtrak—and then hop onto a bus or rideshare once you arrive. Both modes generally accept leashed pets without extra fees. Feel free to let me know if you’d like directions to a particular station or help planning a route!
